remarks: Turnkey living on a flat .57-acre lot in a quiet cul-de-sac with a beautifully manicured yard. This well-maintained Colonial offers 4 bedrooms including a primary ensuite and 2.5 baths. The home features a spacious open living and dining room, plus a comfortable family room with hardwood floors and fireplace. The kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops opens to a bright sunroom with gas fireplace and wet bar perfect for entertaining. Glass sliders lead to a spacious deck where you can watch beautiful sunsets, while the sunroom overlooks the backyard and fills the home with natural light. Lower level offers a flexible workout or playroom. Convenient to the Merritt Parkway, shopping, and all that Greenwich has to offer.
